senses.gloss: m. (δράκων) dragon, Boa Constrictor (v. Sm. Ant. s. v.). [Its figure was used as a military ensign of the Roman cohorts. In Talm. it is considered an emblem of idolatry.] Ab. Zar. III, 3 if one finds vessels ועליהם … צורת ד׳ upon which is the figure of the sun … or of a dragon.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:2">Tosef. ib. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 6:2">VI</cite>), 2 <he>איזהו מין ד׳ שאסור</he> (v. ed. Zuck. note) what kind of serpent is forbidden (as an emblem of idolatry)?; Y. ib. III, 42ᵈ top.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:1">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>תעכסנה</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 3:16">Is. III, 16</cite>; cmp. <he>עָכִיס</he>) <he>שהיתה צורת ד׳ וכ׳</he> the figure of a serpent was on her shoes; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:18">Lam. R. to IV, 15</cite> <he>דרקין</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Gittin 56b:2">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>וד׳ כרוך עליה</he> and a serpent wound around the barrel (allusion to the city of Jerusalem under the terrorism of the extremists). [<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 6:11">Deut. R. s. 6</cite> <he>בא הדרבון</he>, corr. acc.] [Y. Kil. I, 27ᵃ bot. Ar., v. <he>יַרְבּוּו</he>.]
